Applicability may depend on the transition to D.G.R. 3-1937/2025 and the authorization regime in force when applying. Urban-planning compatibility, change of use, hygiene, accessibility, fire safety where required, structural safety, and sector authorization all need verification. The high deterministic score is supported by the property's energy profile, area, and strong reported service-proximity indicators, while regulatory feasibility remains unresolved.
